thread:
alex: anyone else seeing incident-bot pages not leaving the queue? PagerFlow shows a bunch of 429/504 from the outbound-proxy and oncall didn't get paged.
maria: yup noticed it ~4m ago. multiple customers opened SEV tickets. trying to repro with a synthetic alert now.
kenji: logs show outbound-proxy started returning 429 rate_limited at 2023-11-28T15:03:10Z. looks like the global egress rate limiter tripped after a burst.
alex: is this the new autoscaler that retries and spikes outbound concurrency? could be amplifying. @oncall-bot can you post the last 50 outbound attempts for incident-bot?
oncall-bot: pulled outbound logs from last 10m for service=incident-bot -> 47 entries. sample: `{"ts":"2023-11-28T15:03:10Z","status":429,"target":"pagerflow-prod","body":"rate_limited"}`.
dana: paging is still queued in notify-queue with state=DEFERRED. manual requeue doesn't go through.
support-ops: customers impacted: 2 enterprise accounts reported missed pages, one self-serve reported delay ~6m. opening customer-impact thread.
kenji: looking at envoy metrics on outbound-proxy, `upstream_rq_429` spikes correlate with a token bucket refill delay. suspect token-bucket config was tightened in the last deploy.
alex: who rolled outbound-proxy config? @maria did we ship a change to rate limiter yesterday?
maria: I shipped a small tweak to the limiter window to reduce burst capacity for cost reasons. I can revert if needed.
sre-bot: deploy history: outbound-proxy config change by maria at 2023-11-28T02:12:01Z, config id cfg-7752.
kenji: reverting should be low risk. if we revert to previous bucket size, queued pages should flow.
dana: can we escalate manually in the meantime? PD escalation didn't trigger because the bot couldn't reach pagerflow. we need a manual pager to the oncall rotation.
alex: I'll send a manual page and DM the oncall. @ir-bot can you trigger an emergency escalation to the oncall Slack channel and create a PD incident?
ir-bot: creating PD incident... PD incident id INC-8429 created and linked. manual Slack ping to @oncall rotation sent. (reaction: :rotating_light:)
maria: rolling back limiter now. kube rollout undo deployment/outbound-proxy --to-revision=cfg-7751

kenji: logs after rollback: outbound-proxy 200s resuming, backlog draining from notify-queue, requeues processing at ~45r/s.
support-ops: confirmed: customer A acknowledged they received the escalate page at 15:08 UTC. customer B still saw a 3m delay, but no missed pages.
dana: can we add a temporary rule to bypass rate limiting for services with incident severity=critical? that would avoid this amplification in the future.
maria: we can add header-based exemption, `X-Incident-Bypass: true`, but need a follow-up PR and security review.
kenji: adding to the post-incident action items. also let's capture metrics: queue-depth at failure, retry amplification factor, limiter thresholds, and a runbook step to check outbound-proxy token-bucket.
alex: notes for postmortem: root cause = config tightening lowered burst capacity combined with incident-bot retry amplification that exhausted token bucket. mitigation = rollback + manual PD escalation. customer impact = 2 enterprise accounts delayed pages (one missed transiently), ~6m median delay for queued pages.
sre-bot: attached rollout diff: `diff --git a/proxy/config b/proxy/config
index 123abc..7752ef 100644
--- a/proxy/config
+++ b/proxy/config
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ rate_limiter:
-  burst_capacity: 50
+  burst_capacity: 20
  refill_rate_per_sec: 10
`
maria: opened PR #920 to add header-exempt policy and PR #921 to add alerts when `upstream_rq_429 > 5` sustained for 1m.
support-ops: customer comms: drafted message for affected accounts, awaiting legal/pg approval.
kenji: follow-up immediate actions: 1) add a healthcheck alert for notify-queue depth > 100, 2) add an incident-bot mode that disables aggressive retries when downstream returns 429, 3) update runbook with `kubectl logs -f deployment/outbound-proxy | grep rate_limited`.
alex: good. anyone want to do a quick blameless postmortem doc? I'll start the template.
maria: I'll own the config PR + test harness to simulate burst.
dana: I'll handle customer comms and PD follow-ups.
kenji: I'll write the postmortem action items and schedule a 30m retro tomorrow.
support-ops: adding label `sev:high` and `automation:outbound-rate-limiter` to the PD incident.
alex: thanks all. leaving this thread open for any late artifacts. (reaction: :thumbsup:)
